en.title: Grouting equipment
en.seoTitle: Grouting pumps and grouting equipment | Betongakuten
en.description: Grouting pumps, mixers and complete plants from Häny, equipment from REED and data logging from Jean Lutz. Advice and quotes.

blocks.html: Grouting is used to reinforce, seal and anchor, in rock, soil and concrete and in tunnelling. We supply pumps, mixers and complete plants, equipment for documentation and for handling dry material, and help you choose the right setup for the job.
Read our guide How to choose grouting equipment or contact us directly.

items.q: Which grouting pump should I choose?
items.a: It depends on the material, pressure, flow and how automated the job should be. Häny has manual units (IC), automatic plants (FAIC) and pumps up to 200 bar. Read our guide or contact us.
Yes, with sensors, data loggers and displays from Jean Lutz for pressure, flow and volume.
